title: [spec-gap][R-07-047] Priority MUST NOT preempt committed RX or admit TX without guard-fit opportunity: unimplemented in all stacks
description: spec/07-transport-app.md:614-619: 'Priority MUST NOT preempt committed RX, exceed legal or adaptive airtime limits, or admit TX unless the full radio operation plus guard fits the available opportunity. Waiting packets remain subject to bounded radio queues, backpressure, and deadlines.' NO stack implements any of the three clauses: (a) no committed-RX concept exists (rg 'committed RX|committed_rx|preempt committed' = specs/docs only); (b) TX admission checks only the general duty-cycle budget + per-TX dwell (rust duty_cycle.rs:613, C lora_l2_tx.c:500-509, py RegionalDutyCycleEnforcer) with no receiver peer-contract / advertised-channel / receive-opportunity eligibility; (c) no guard-fit check that the full radio operation plus guard fits the remaining opportunity. Cross-graded in docs/spec-coverage/11-lci.md:48 (R-11-033 not-implemented) and docs/spec-coverage/12-apps.md R-12-065 with no implementing bead until now. Suggested placement: extend TX admission in rust/lichen-core/src/tx_queue.rs pop_if_allowed + transport.rs send path, C lora_l2_tx.c admission gate, py coap/transport.py congestion check - all need a receiver-aware eligibility input (peer rx channel + opportunity from CCP/02b receiver-aware work). Gate this on the receiver-aware CCP spec (02b) conformance oracles the spec says gate new wire behavior.
